report.limitation: Leave-one-out cross-validation over 300 North Indian Ocean storms: mean absolute error 21.9 kt against a flat median baseline of 21.0 kt. This is a statistical estimate about past storms, not a forecast about any future one, and it is not the surge figure — that comes from the deterministic law and remains authoritative.
